PaletteMatrix.dc.html.title: All six palettes · Home, Tally, Diary entry, Settings

Settings.dc.html.title: Settings · tap a faceplate to preview

setNote.text:
Settings · faceplates
Tap any faceplate and the whole app recolours at once (try it in Play).
Free: Cloud Candy, Lilac Sky, Peach Fuzz. Unlock: Peach Soda at 100 nvms, Orchid Pop at 30 diary lines, Midnight CD at $1,000 kept.
A locked one is a free try-on: the preview bar offers to switch back, and the app returns to her palette when she leaves Settings.

onbNote.text:
Onboarding
Three screens at most, skip on every one. No account, budget or setup needed to start; sign in is offered later, when she wants backup.
The palette picked on screen 2 applies straight away. Screen 3's nvm! plays the normal reward.

signNote.text:
Sign in
Use the system Sign in with Apple button in the build (logo + style from Apple's guidelines); it is shown here as a plain placeholder.
Errors say what happened and how to fix it, in words, never colour alone. Loading is the only spinner-style state in the app, because it really waits on the network.

lockNote.text:
App lock
Off by default, offered after her first diary entry. Locks the diary or the whole app (her choice).
Face ID opens on its own; passcode is the fallback after a failed scan or by tapping. Six digits, haptic tick per key, no lockout shaming.

splashNote.text:
Splash
Expo shows it as a static image while the app boots: export the artboard at 3x (1170 × 2532) with background #F6CDEB as the fallback colour.
Optional handoff (400 ms): the coin settles into the cloud with a small bounce, then the screen cross-fades to Home. No spinner, because logs load from the phone first.
Reduced motion: straight cross-fade.

logNote.text:
Quick log flow
Only amount + name are required. Category, note and photo stay optional.
Tapping nvm! saves on the phone first, closes the sheet and plays the Reward moment. No spinners, even offline; photos upload in the background.
In Play: Home's + opens Quick log, nvm! opens the Reward, tap anywhere returns Home.

motion.text:
Reward motion (all within ~1.2 s, tap anywhere skips)
0 ms: veil fades in, success haptic
0–300 ms: coin drops from the top with a springy overshoot
180 ms: sparkle burst pops out and fades by 500 ms
200–700 ms: tally digits roll up like an old counter, one keypad blip per digit
300 ms: +$ chip floats up 12 px
700 ms: sticker window pops open (scale 0.85 to 1, 220 ms spring) if one dropped
Rare: one 600 ms holo sweep across the CD, then still
Reduced motion: one 200 ms fade, final numbers shown, reward stays visible

tallyNote.text:
Tally
Bars count what she kept, never what she spent. Bought-after-all items drop out of every total.
Savings and debt tags show only as a quiet side total, so the main number stays fun.
Rows open Item detail. The loved button opens the Loved list.

itemNote.text:
Item detail
Bought it after all: one tap, kind message, item leaves the tally, nothing is lost and it can be undone.
Delete asks once in a bottom sheet. Keep it is the primary (safe) button; the sheet points to bought it after all as the gentler option.

diaryNote.text:
Diary
Stars and moods only ever add up. Empty days look calm, never greyed out or marked missed.
Diary sits behind App lock once she turns it on (offered after her first entry).

entryNote.text:
Diary entry
Every field is optional except saving something: one line, or only a mood, counts as showing up.
Saving plays the same reward family as a log: star, burst, haptic, and the 1 in 3 sticker chance.
The shuffle button swaps the prompt; prompts never repeat within a week.

decorNote.text:
Decorate page
Drag from the tray onto the page. One finger moves, pinch resizes, twist rotates. Handles give the same controls for one-finger and accessibility use.
Each placed sticker saves x, y, scale and rotation (relative to the page) plus a z order.
Removing a sticker sends it back to the tray; nothing is ever used up for good.

lovedNote.text:
Loved list
Opened from Tally. Photo-led, two columns, one month at a time.
Anything counts: things, songs, places, nights out. Photo and price are optional; without a photo the card shows a sticker.
Never adds to or subtracts from the kept tally. Feeds the monthly recap card.

collNote.text:
Collection
Stars and milestones never reset. Missing album slots are soft dashed outlines, never greyed-out failures.
Packs unlock from milestones only. Nothing is bought; a locked pack shows exactly what unlocks it and how close she is.

mileNote.text:
Milestone motion
Full screen, shown once after the action that crossed it, after the normal reward.
0 ms haptic success + chiptune fanfare (sounds optional)
0–400 ms window pops open, holo glow fades in behind it
300–900 ms number counts up from the previous milestone
900 ms comparison card slides up, then the unlock card if any
Reduced motion: one fade, final number shown. Milestones: $100, $250, $500, $1,000 kept; 10, 50, 100 logs; 10, 30 diary lines.

goalNote.text:
Goal
One goal at a time. Progress uses the kept total since the goal was set; no deadline, no budget.
Reaching it plays a milestone, then offers a new goal or keep counting. Editing the target never takes progress away.

recapNote.text:
Recap
Week or month, wanted (didn't buy) or loved. Wanted shows prices and the kept total; loved shows dates, never prices.
The preview is the real card. Save exports 1080 × 1920 PNG to Photos; share opens the iOS share sheet.
Monthly cards are a CD in a jewel case with a track list; weekly cards are a retro window. A big month shows the top 10 plus a +N more line.
